summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Room Management features for Realtor Dashboard. Backend: 14/14 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All room management UI features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_* prefixed rooms during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Room management features fully implemented and tested. Backend APIs: POST /api/properties/{id}/rooms (add single room), DELETE /api/properties/{id}/rooms/{room_id} (delete room), POST /api/properties/{id}/rooms/bulk (bulk add), POST /api/properties/{id}/analyze-floor-plan (upload + AI analysis). Floor plan images saved to /app/backend/uploads/floor_plans/. GPT-4o Vision integration via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is LIVE (not mocked).

POST /api/properties/{id}/rooms.details: Adds single room with automatic area calculations (floor_area, wall_area, ceiling_area). Returns {message, room_id}

DELETE /api/properties/{id}/rooms/{room_.details: Removes room from property. Returns {message: 'Kamer verwijderd'}

POST /api/properties/{id}/rooms/bulk.details: Adds multiple rooms at once. Returns {message, rooms_added: count}

POST /api/properties/{id}/analyze-floor-.details: Accepts file upload, saves to /uploads/floor_plans/, updates property.floor_plan_url. Returns AI-detected rooms if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY present

Frontend: Kamers section header with cou.details: Shows 'Kamers (N)' where N is room count. Updates dynamically

Frontend: + Kamer button.details: data-testid='add-room-btn'. Opens inline form with fields: Naam, Type (dropdown), L(m), B(m), H(m)

Frontend: Grondplan uploaden button.details: data-testid='upload-floor-plan-btn'. Accepts image/*, .pdf files. Shows 'Analyseren...' during upload

Frontend: Existing rooms display.details: 2-column grid showing room name and area. Delete button (X) appears on hover

Frontend: Room delete on hover.details: Delete button with opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100. Calls DELETE API and shows 'Kamer verwijderd' toast

Frontend: Add room form submission.details: Submit via data-testid='submit-room-btn'. Shows 'Kamer toegevoegd' toast. List updates without page reload

Frontend: Floor plan saved indicator.details: 'Grondplan opgeslagen' shown in blue banner when floor_plan_url exists on property

Frontend: AI suggestions UI.details: data-testid='ai-suggestions' shows detected rooms with checkboxes. Editable name/type/dimensions. Save with 'N kamers toevoegen' button

Room area calculation.details: Correct calculation: floor_area = L×W, ceiling_area = L×W, wall_area = 2×(L+W)×H

Authorization checks.details: All endpoints require Bearer token. Returns 401 without auth
